title: Your free business page
summary: Every business gets a free page at usetikka.com/your-name. Put it in your Instagram and WhatsApp bio.

steps.title: Open Your page
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Your page. On a computer, it's in the menu on the left.

steps.title: Add what people ask about
steps.body:
Add a headline, a hero photo, what you offer and what it costs, your hours and location, and answers to the questions people always ask before they book.

Everything is optional. Add what you have and come back for the rest.

steps.title: Share the address
steps.body: Copy your page address and put it in your Instagram bio, your WhatsApp Business profile and anywhere else people find you. When you're running a drop, your page shows it.

tips: Your business page is always free, even when you're not running a drop.
